question: Does each quantized Qwen3.8-27B build retain BF16 pass behaviour on a public, licence-compatible reasoning/knowledge benchmark, measured item-paired?
primary_metric: paired BF16-pass retention on MMLU-Pro exact letter answers
paired_unit: one MMLU-Pro question with its frozen five-shot category prefix
acceptance: a candidate passes when BF16-pass retention has a Wilson 95% lower bound at or above 0.90 and no category loses more than two BF16 passes; anything else is published as a measured shortfall
failure_outcome: publish the shortfall with raw outputs; do not retune prompts, sampling, or scorer after seeing results

inputs.partition_policy: whole public test split is eligible; selection is content-addressed and fixed before any run; the 70-row validation split supplies the official five-shot prefixes only
inputs.exclusions_decided_before_results: none beyond the pinned revision and the official category set

controls.sampling: temperature 0, greedy, thinking enabled at low reasoning effort, max_tokens 5120
controls.warmup: server readiness plus vLLM multi-modal warmup only; no benchmark warm-up items
controls.randomness_controls: no sampling randomness; request concurrency does not affect per-item determinism

output_schema: qwen38-public-capability/1 with per-item raw request, raw response, extracted letter, gold letter, and digests

runtime.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

amendment.reason: the first frozen plan capped completions at 2048 tokens; the BF16 control hit that cap on 7/70 items (finish_reason length, no letter emitted), which measures the cap and not the model. Observed prompts reach 2584 tokens against an 8192 window, so the cap is raised to 5120 completion tokens before any candidate is run. No prompt, selection, scorer, or acceptance rule changed; the truncated control receipt is retained.

acceptance_addendum: an item whose completion ends with finish_reason length and no explicit letter counts as a failure for that model; the count is published per model
